name: chatslide
description: Turn an outline into a real, editable presentation you can restyle and export to PPTX or PDF.

interface.longDescription: Draft the slides in the conversation, then let ChatSlide render them into an editable presentation. The deck opens in the ChatSlide editor, where it can be restyled with templates and palettes, illustrated, and exported to PPTX or PDF. ChatSlide only receives the outline you ask it to turn into a deck.
capabilities: Create a presentation from an outline
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-slide deck about our Q3 results.
Turn this conversation into a presentation.
Build slides explaining how photosynthesis works for a high school class.

positive.description: Build a deck from a topic
positive.prompt: Make a 10-slide deck about the history of the bicycle.
positive.expected_behavior: Drafts ten slide titles with bullets, calls create_deck once, and returns a chatslide.ai link that opens the drafted deck.

positive.description: Build a deck from the conversation so far
positive.prompt: Turn everything we just discussed into a presentation.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the conversation into slides and returns a link whose deck matches what was discussed.

positive.prompt: Give me exactly 5 slides on remote onboarding.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a link to a deck with exactly five slides.

positive.description: Build a deck in another language
positive.prompt: 做一个关于中国高铁的 8 页演示文稿。
positive.expected_behavior: Slide titles and bullets are in Chinese, language is set to zh-CN, and the link opens that deck.

positive.prompt: Open the deck you just made.
positive.expected_behavior: The link opens the ChatSlide outline step with the drafted slides already filled in, ready to generate.

negative.prompt: Show me the decks already in my ChatSlide account.
Upgrade my ChatSlide plan and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Creating and exporting a deck happens on chatslide.ai under the user's own account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create_deck turns a drafted outline into an editable ChatSlide presentation.
